title: App and Feature Selector
description: Study the implementation in [backend/app.py] and [autoeda/feature_selector.py]. Trace its declarations and dependencies into a caller or test. Prominent declared symbols visible in the inspected excerpt include is_valid_email, is_strong_password, validate_contact_form, handle_contact, signup, remove_low_variance, remove_highly_correlated; confirm their complete definitions and callers in the file.

learning_objectives.text: Explain the source role and visible behavior in backend/app.py, autoeda/feature_selector.py.
Trace a declaration, setting, or documented claim to a caller, test, or implementation path.
Separate source evidence, documentation claims, and unverified runtime behavior.

completion_criteria: Submit the code-trace exercise meeting all acceptance criteria.
